description: Demanio accidentale strade regionali trasferite dallo Stato is a dataset listed in Italian national open data portal, an open data portal, published or maintained by Regione Lazio. Il dataset contiene le strade statali (SS) passate sotto il controllo della Regione. Il Dataset è l'allegato A.2 del "Libro8" del DIPARTIMENTO PROGRAMMAZIONE ECONOMICA E SOCIALE - Direzione Regionale Programmazione Economica, Bilancio, Demanio e Patrimonio - Inventario dei Beni Immobili Regionali. Il dataeset è estratto dal sistema PATIMM. Coverage: Regione Lazio. The portal files it under the publisher Regione Lazio. Its tags are strade. It offers 2 resource(s) in CSV, XLSX. The portal shows 2026-08-04 as the last metadata change. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is CC-BY-4.0. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. It can support traffic, parking and road network studies. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-ckan-it-portal.
